component.name: Conflux
component.summary: Keep folders in sync with your cloud, git and disks

description.p: Conflux sets up and watches conflux, a sync daemon that keeps local folders in step with a WebDAV server such as Nextcloud, a git repository, or another folder, or keeps a git clone up to date. The configuration stays a plain file you can also edit by hand.

ul.li: Every sync with its live status: when it last ran, what it changed, what failed
Sync now, or preview what a sync would change
Edit syncs, remotes and defaults; comments and layout in the file are kept
Run a daemon per profile, start it at login, and read its log
The system-wide setup too, unlocked with an administrator's password

description.p: The conflux daemon is installed separately, from the conflux package.
